title: AI and Global Flourishing
description:
My serious and sober attempt to justify and direct optimism about AI.

Articles and Videos Referenced:
- *Protein Folding:* https://interestingengineering.com/science/deepmind-alphafold-protein-engineering
- *Animal Language:* https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-025-02917-9
- *Climate Crisis:* https://www.foodandwaterwatch.org/2025/04/09/artificial-intelligence-water-climate/
- *Efficent Grids:* https://spectrum.ieee.org/ai-water-usage
- *Efficient Water:* https://www.analyticsinsight.net/artificial-intelligence/ai-in-smart-irrigation-and-water-management-systems
- *Fusion:* https://www.weforum.org/stories/2025/12/how-ai-will-help-get-fusion-from-lab-to-grid-by-the-2030s/
- *Space Datacenters:* https://fortune.com/2025/12/01/google-ceo-sundar-pichai-project-suncatcher-extraterrestrial-data-centers-environment/
- *Asteroid Mining:* https://spacenews.com/uks-asteroid-mining-corp-unveils-scar-e-robot/
- *Unemployment:* https://futurism.com/former-google-ai-exec-law-medicine
- *Universal Basic Income:* https://www.foxbusiness.com/economy/musk-predicts-ai-create-universal-high-income-make-saving-money-unnecessary
- *Trump's AI Czar:* https://www.businessinsider.com/trump-ai-czar-david-sacks-universal-basic-income-ai-jobs-2025-6
- *Oligarchy:* https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/businessreview/2025/09/15/seven-ceos-in-trumps-ai-dinner-shape-americas-tech-destiny/
- *Democratic Reform:* https://youtu.be/3eFMcPVfbdI
- *New Economic Systems:* https://blog.samaltman.com/three-observations
- *Algorithmic Bias:* https://medcitynews.com/2025/12/ai-decides-who-gets-care-algorithmic-bias-in-post-acute-care-decisions/
- *Better Data Sets:* https://theconversation.com/far-fewer-americans-support-political-violence-than-recent-polls-suggest-266113
- *Deskilling:* https://www.businessinsider.com/anthropic-ceo-ai-90-percent-code-3-to-6-months-2025-3
- *Automation:* https://www.transformernews.ai/p/claude-code-is-about-so-much-more
- *Loss of Trust:* https://www.nytimes.com/2026/01/05/technology/nicolas-maduro-ai-images-deepfakes.html
